title: Snitch cluster (pulp-platform/snitch_cluster)
_note: PULP's many-core Snitch cluster: the Snitch integer core and its compute
core wrapper, the FP subsystem, the IPU, the SSR streamer, the VM / TLB, the
memory interface and the cluster itself, plus the dependency IP that is not
already a family of its own -- the cluster i-cache, core_ips, the CORE-V
XIF, the reqrsp interface, the SCM register files and the Spatz vector unit.
Closure by the SHARED test/ext_ip/bender_setup.sh, the third family to use
it unchanged after pulpissimo and cheshire: bender installed as a prebuilt
binary, `bender checkout` against the checked-in Bender.lock so all 19
dependencies are pinned, and .bender_resolved/<package> symlinks so the
hash-suffixed checkout directories stay out of roots and incdirs.  Like
cheshire it needed no per-dependency patching.
exclude_srcs carries cheshire's verification exclusions for the same reason:
Bender lists axi/src/axi_test.sv (testbench utilities, queues formatted with
`%h` that read_slang rejects) as a package source, and it would otherwise
land in every closure.
sweep_paths covers the cluster's own hw/ and the new packages only; axi,
common_cells, fpnew (swept as cvfpu), register_interface, apb,
tech_cells_generic, common_verification, riscv-dbg, fpu_div_sqrt_mvp, idma,
obi, axi_stream and axi_riscv_atomics stay available to every closure but
are not counted twice.
First local sweep 2026-10-28 (104 rows): 29 / 49 comparable proven, 44 / 49
elaborate, 38 co-sim PASS, 60 rows with 0 undriven, 1.3 h of row time.
Same caveat as cheshire, and for the same reason: 39 rows skip because
PULP's type parameters do not elaborate at their DEFAULTS and 16 more have
no read_slang reference, so only 49 of the 104 rows are comparable.  The
`snitch` core itself is one of the unreferenced rows -- its load-store unit
(which genuinely lives in the core_ips package; the closure picks the right
file) forms the REVERSED part-select `caq_qaddr_i[2:3]` once CaqTagWidth
defaults to 0, and read_slang rejects a reversed range where Surelog
tolerates it.  Nothing to fix on our side: at a non-zero CaqTagWidth the
select is legal, so this is a default-parameter artefact, not a source bug
to patch.
Leads worth working, all slang-CLEAN so all adjudicated:
* spatz_vfu: 170 co-simulated divergences (the Spatz vector functional
unit) -- the biggest adjudicated lead this family brings.
* spatz_ipu: 77.
* register_file_3r_2w_be: 265, and its miter runs out of memory, so the
co-sim is the only oracle -- the same row shape pulpissimo also flags.
* spatz_simd_lane: 1.
Formal-only `differs` with no co-sim divergence: dspu,
snitch_cluster_peripheral_reg and two register-file test wrappers.
Three rows cannot elaborate: snitch_cluster (the whole cluster) and the two
interface shims lsu_to_tcdm_intf / tcdm_mux_intf.
